theme: Our home — Haryana, Gurugram, the Chief Minister, Delhi-NCR

questions.question: What is the capital of Haryana?
questions.funFact: Chandigarh was one of India's first planned cities and was designed by the French architect Le Corbusier.

questions.question: Gurugram, a big city in Haryana, was earlier called by which name?
questions.funFact: The city's name was officially changed from Gurgaon to Gurugram in 2016.

questions.question: Who is the Chief Minister of Haryana (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: Nayab Singh Saini became the Chief Minister of Haryana in 2024.

questions.question: Haryana was formed as a separate state in the year 1966.
questions.funFact: Haryana was carved out of Punjab on 1 November 1966, so 1 November is celebrated as Haryana Day.

questions.question: Gurugram is part of the Delhi-NCR, where NCR stands for the National ___ Region.
questions.funFact: The National Capital Region groups Delhi together with nearby cities like Gurugram, Faridabad and Noida.

questions.question: Gurugram is best known as a busy hub for which of these?
questions.funFact: Because it grew so fast with tall office towers, Gurugram is nicknamed the 'Millennium City'.

questions.question: Chandigarh is the shared capital of both Haryana and Punjab.
questions.funFact: Chandigarh is a Union Territory that acts as the capital for two states at once.

questions.question: Which city is NOT part of the Delhi-NCR region?
questions.funFact: Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra, far away on India's west coast, not near Delhi.

questions.question: The holy site Kurukshetra, linked to the Mahabharata, is in which state?
questions.funFact: It is believed that the Bhagavad Gita was spoken at Kurukshetra in Haryana during the great Mahabharata war.

questions.question: Haryana has produced many Olympic medal winners, especially in wrestling and ___.
questions.funFact: So many champions come from Haryana that it is often called India's 'medal factory'; javelin star Neeraj Chopra is from Panipat in Haryana.

questions.question: Faridabad is one of the largest cities in Haryana.
questions.funFact: Faridabad, near Delhi, is a big industrial city and one of the most populated cities in Haryana.

questions.question: Which language is the official language of Haryana?
questions.funFact: Hindi is the official language of Haryana, and many people also speak the local Haryanvi way of talking.
